mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.2%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 7.0% indicates improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 7.0%, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (both rising above 0.5% month-over-month) signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth > 0.5% MoM and RSAFS growth > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS grow above 0.5% MoM, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In the early recovery phase, rising industrial production (INDPRO above 103.0) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that supports economic growth and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the early recovery phase (defined by GDP growth >1% and UNRATE >7.0%), INDPRO growth does not lead to positive 60d returns (i.e., returns are negative in >60% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS above 340,000 million) consistently indicate healthy consumer spending that drives corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 340,000 million.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.2% signals the start of monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises above 0.2%, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% month-over-month) combined with declining unemployment (UNRATE falling more than 0.2 percentage points) indicates a rapidly improving labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls more than 0.2pp, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion phase, strong housing starts (HOUST above 560.0 thousand) signal potential overvaluation in the housing market that precedes a correction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, high HOUST (above 560.0) does not lead to negative 20d returns (i.e., returns are positive in more than 60% of such cases).
